name: Wattle
description: Star of 5,616 K, 268 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: WASP-19
quotes.card: WASP-19, formally named Wattle, is a magnitude 12.3 star about 869 light-years away, located in the Vela constellation of the Southern Hemisphere.
quotes.introduction: This star has been found to host a transiting hot Jupiter-type planet in a tight orbit.
